title: コンピュータアーキテクチャ設計
subtitle: Computer Architecture and Design
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the processor organization through circuit design. (2) learn processor components. (3) learn to design the basic processor. (4) learn to design advanced processors with additional instructions.
advice: This is an advanced computer architecture course. The knowledge learned in this subject is the foundation for AI and IoT technologies. We will cover the following materials: 1. Design method of logic circuits 2. Design of processor components 3. Design of basic processor 4. Design of advanced processors
books: コンピュータアーキテクチャ[コロナ社]
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of radix conversion, basic knowledge of logic circuit operations such as adder, selector, and register are required. Students should also understand data flow and control flow in the processor and basic usage of the “Logisim” logic simulator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the circuit design procedures that are used in logic circuit simulators.
Be able to design small processor components from functional specifications.
Be able to conduct basic processor design from functional specifications.
Be able to add instructions to the basic processor.
Be able to verify a processor function using an assembler.
